Percentes pilot report (SPEC-HOSTED HA2)
instrument commit: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
config sha256: abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab

DEMONSTRATION: Percentes chose this pair to show the report and its method. A pair named by a reader replaces it.

CAVEAT: two hosted endpoints measured from one client host, in consecutive windows on each session date. Every timing is client-observed from intended dispatch, and the model weights and serving stack behind each model identifier are not verifiable (SPEC-HOSTED §6). No service-level objective (SLO) is defined for hosted data, so latency is reported as distributions with no pass bar (SPEC-HOSTED §7).

== Disclosures ==
- One author: Percentes has one author. No second person checked the instrument, the cases, the labels or this report.
- Roles: task chosen by Percentes; cases and labels supplied by a deterministic generator; rubric written by Percentes; interest of the person who named the pair: none; Percentes chose the pair.
- Cases: synthetic support tickets from a deterministic generator, labelled by construction. Their realism is limited, and they are not validated as production quality.
- The same measured cases run in every session, in a per-session order, so the sessions are not independent task examples.
- Output ceiling, the same value on both endpoints: groq max_completion_tokens=4096; baseten max_tokens=4096.
- Both endpoints were sent the model identifier openai/gpt-oss-120b. A shared identifier does not establish identical weights, numerical precision or backend versions.

== Environment pins (SPEC-HOSTED §6) ==
not applicable or not verifiable against a hosted endpoint: ignore_eos and any output-length forcing; the model weights and revision behind the identifier; KV (key-value) cache budget; prefix-caching state; continuous-batching verification; serving-stack version and image digest; scheduler settings; CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) graph enablement; GPU (graphics processing unit) SKU (stock-keeping unit), driver, and clock and power fingerprints; the Kubernetes, CNI (Container Network Interface), dataplane, kube-proxy, and node-monitor-grace-period pins; per-replica request counters

== Endpoints ==
groq: provider Groq, account tier Developer, requested model openai/gpt-oss-120b, params {"max_completion_tokens":4096,"reasoning_effort":"low","reasoning_format":"parsed","stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}
baseten: provider Baseten, account tier Basic, requested model openai/gpt-oss-120b, params {"max_tokens":4096,"reasoning_effort":"low","stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}
frozen labels: billing, technical, account, escalation
